answer: The lacemaker pillow sits by the window, pins bristling in the parchment pattern. Bone wick shadeweaver chimneyshop brand — a brand wick shadeweavers set twice chimneyshop glass tallies hold. copper crosses the bobbins over and under and pins each twist in place. trellis works the ground stitch slow, keeping the tension even. onyx lifts the finished lace off the pins and rolls it round the card. Earning this count means making 26 yards without one pattern slipping off the pins, and the next still puckers where a bobbin ran slack.
